notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR! (+ WMR & OCULUS INFO)
notes.content:
We are kicking off the new lunar year with a language update for Rosebaker’s Icy Treats, which is now also playable in chinese, russian and german.

Based on your feedback, we tweaked the campaign to add more ingredient variety right from the beginning. This will alter running campaigns with a score lower than than 7500, so don’t get confused by some extra unlocks when you continue. 

We still need to put some extra work into the official support for Oculus and Mixed RealityHead Mounted Display, but we are happy to announce that the game is already running on both systems through SteamVR, so feel free to give it a try (though you’ll need a 360° setup for Oculus).

To celebrate the year of the dog, we also added a new skin for the umbrella.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30255941/b59c8af7d739985a8cc0b329d771956f59974d84.png[/img] 

We wish you good fortune for the new year and a lot of fun with Rosebaker’s Icy Treats!

notes.title: ROSEBAKER‘S ICY TREATS REACHES v1.0
notes.content:
We‘re happy to announce that Rosebaker‘s Icy Treats has now Gone Gold and is available in the Steam store right now!

Rosebaker‘s Icy Treats being our first game, we‘d love to hear your feedback! If you want to tell us what you like or don‘t like about the game, you want to say hi, or maybe you ran into a glitch, don‘t hesitate to contact us! Both of us are passionate about what we‘re doing and we hope you enjoy the game!
